title.en: If you want to ~ / In order to ~ (-(으)려면)

sentences.target: -(으)려면은 어떤 목적이나 의도를 이루기 위한 조건을 제시할 때 사용한다.
sentences.en: The form -(으)려면 is used to present the condition required to achieve a goal or intention.

sentences.target: '~하려면'의 의미로, 뒤 절에 필요한 행동이나 상황이 따른다.
sentences.en: It corresponds to “if you want to ~” or “in order to ~,” followed by the necessary action.

sentences.target: 목표 달성을 위해 선행되어야 할 조건을 자연스럽게 말할 때 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It is used when naturally stating what must come first to reach a desired result.

sentences.target: 조언, 지시, 제안 등에서 매우 자주 등장한다.
sentences.en: It appears very frequently in advice, instructions, and suggestions.

sentences.target: 화자가 생각하는 '필요 조건'을 강조할 때 적합하다.
sentences.en: It is suitable when emphasizing a requirement the speaker considers important.

sentences.target: 공식적 상황과 비격식 상황 모두에서 널리 사용된다.
sentences.en: It is widely used in both formal and informal contexts.

sentences.target: 의도·계획과 연결되기 때문에 미래지향적 문맥이 많다.
sentences.en: Because it relates to intention and planning, it often appears in future-oriented situations.

sentences.target: 뒤 절에는 '~해야 한다', '~하는 게 좋다', '~해라'와 같은 표현이 자주 온다.
sentences.en: The following clause often includes expressions like “you need to,” “you should,” or “you must.”

sentences.target: 상대에게 행동을 유도하는 기능을 포함할 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can subtly guide or encourage the listener’s action.

sentences.target: 목표와 조건의 관계가 분명해야 자연스러운 문장이 된다.
sentences.en: The relationship between the goal and the condition must be clear for the sentence to sound natural.

sentences.target: 합격하려면 더 열심히 공부해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to pass, you need to study harder.

sentences.target: 시간을 맞추려면 지금 출발해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to be on time, you need to leave now.

sentences.target: 건강해지려면 꾸준히 운동해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to get healthier, you should exercise regularly.

sentences.target: 말을 잘하려면 많이 연습해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to speak well, you need to practice a lot.

sentences.target: 문제를 해결하려면 원인을 먼저 알아야 해.
sentences.en: To solve the problem, you need to find the cause first.

sentences.target: 잘 되려면 준비가 필요해.
sentences.en: If you want things to go well, preparation is necessary.

sentences.target: 돈을 모으려면 소비를 줄여야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to save money, you need to cut your spending.

sentences.target: 체력을 기르려면 규칙적인 생활이 필요해.
sentences.en: If you want to build stamina, you need a regular routine.

sentences.target: 실수를 줄이려면 집중해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to reduce mistakes, you need to focus.

sentences.target: 시험을 통과하려면 기본 개념을 정확히 알아야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to pass the exam, you must understand the basics clearly.

sentences.target: 맛있게 만들려면 간을 잘 맞춰야 해.
sentences.en: If you want it to taste good, you need to season it well.

sentences.target: 정시에 도착하려면 서둘러야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to arrive on time, you should hurry.

sentences.target: 목표를 이루려면 작은 것부터 실천하는 게 좋아.
sentences.en: If you want to achieve your goals, it’s best to start with small actions.

sentences.target: 문제를 피하려면 미리 확인해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to avoid problems, you should double-check things in advance.

sentences.target: 성공하려면 꾸준함이 가장 중요해.
sentences.en: If you want to succeed, consistency is the most important thing.

sentences.target: 좋은 인상을 주려면 약속 시간을 지켜야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to make a good impression, you need to be punctual.

sentences.target: 효율적으로 일하려면 우선순위를 정해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to work efficiently, you should set your priorities.

sentences.target: 긴장을 풀려면 깊게 호흡하는 게 좋아.
sentences.en: If you want to relax, take deep breaths.

sentences.target: 팀워크를 높이려면 서로 신뢰해야 해.
sentences.en: To improve teamwork, you need to trust each other.

sentences.target: 변화를 만들려면 행동부터 시작해야 해.
sentences.en: If you want to make a change, you need to start acting first.
